subtitle.ar: وصية الإمام أبي حنيفة لتلميذه يوسف بن خالد السمتي
subtitle.en: The Imam's parting advice to his student Yusuf ibn Khalid al-Samti

siblings.note: Original classical text — verify wording against a printed edition (e.g. al-Khatib al-Baghdadi's Tarikh Baghdad / manaqib literature) before authoring.

attribution.ar: إعادة صياغة مبسّطة لوصية الإمام أبي حنيفة (ت ١٥٠هـ) لتلميذه يوسف بن خالد السمتي عند عودته إلى البصرة.
attribution.en: Simplified retelling of Imam Abu Hanifa's (d. 150 AH) testament to his student Yusuf ibn Khalid al-Samti upon his return to Basra. Original retelling written for this app; classical source consulted for content.
